local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Guard: the world (plaza + plot ring) and all services must be started exactly once.
-- A duplicate start is benign, so it returns without a warning, but it is counted for diagnosis.
if workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeWorldBuilt") == true then
	local okT, telem = pcall(function()
		return require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 5))
	end)
	if okT and type(telem) == "table" and type(telem.count) == "function" then
		pcall(telem.count, "duplicate_start", 1)
	end
	return
end
workspace:SetAttribute("ForgeWorldBuilt", true)

-- Diagnostic output about optional hooks is only shown when this attribute is set on workspace.
local function debugEnabled(): boolean
	return workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeDebug") == true
end

local Config: any = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"))
local ForgeTelemetry: any = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))
local PlotBuilder: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlotBuilder"))
local PlazaBuilder: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlazaBuilder"))
local PlotClaimService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PlotClaimService"))
local UpgradeService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("UpgradeService"))
local RebirthService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("RebirthService"))
local TutorialService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("TutorialService"))
local DataService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local JuiceService: any = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("JuiceService"))

-- CashInService runs the collector (cube -> Cash, cubes_collected); it must be started.
local CashInService: any = nil
do
	local cashInModule = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("CashInService", 5)
	if cashInModule and cashInModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local okReq, result = pcall(require, cashInModule)
		if okReq then
			CashInService = result
		else
			warn("CashInService require failed: " .. tostring(result))
		end
	end
end

-- Remotes
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTES_FOLDER)
if not remotes then
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = Config.REMOTES_FOLDER
	f.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	remotes = f
end
if not (remotes :: Instance):FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY) then
	local ev = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	ev.Name = Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY
	ev.Parent = remotes
end

-- Calls the first function found under any of the given names.
-- Hooks are optional: a module that does not implement one is silently skipped
-- (a note is printed only when the ForgeDebug workspace attribute is true).
local missingLogged: { [string]: boolean } = {}
local function callFirst(module: any, names: { string }, ...: any): (boolean, any)
	if type(module) ~= "table" then
		return false, nil
	end
	for _, name in names do
		local fn = module[name]
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
			if not ok then
				warn(name .. " failed: " .. tostring(result))
			end
			return ok, result
		end
	end
	if debugEnabled() then
		local key = table.concat(names, "/")
		if not missingLogged[key] then
			missingLogged[key] = true
			print("[Forge] optional hook not implemented: " .. key)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

-- Data: initialise once at startup (before any player is handled)
callFirst(DataService, { "init" })

-- Juice: lighting style + juice remotes, once at startup (before any player is handled)
callFirst(JuiceService, { "init" })

-- World: base, plaza, plots (each built exactly once)
local built = false
local plazaCenter = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
local plots: { any } = {}

local function buildWorld()
	if built then
		return
	end
	built = true

	callFirst(PlotBuilder, { "buildBase" })

	-- Baseplate styling (no default grey)
	local baseplate = workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
	if baseplate and baseplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		if typeof(Config.BASEPLATE_COLOR) == "Color3" then
			baseplate.Color = Config.BASEPLATE_COLOR
		end
		if typeof(Config.BASEPLATE_MATERIAL) == "EnumItem" then
			baseplate.Material = Config.BASEPLATE_MATERIAL
		end
	end

	local okPlaza, plaza = callFirst(PlazaBuilder, { "buildPlaza", "build", "create" })
	if okPlaza and plaza ~= nil then
		if typeof(plaza) == "CFrame" then
			plazaCenter = (plaza :: CFrame).Position
		elseif typeof(plaza) == "Vector3" then
			plazaCenter = plaza :: Vector3
		elseif type(plaza) == "table" then
			local c = plaza.spawnCFrame or plaza.centerCFrame or plaza.center or plaza.spawn
			if typeof(c) == "CFrame" then
				plazaCenter = c.Position
			elseif typeof(c) == "Vector3" then
				plazaCenter = c
			end
		end
	end

	local plotCount: number = Config.PLOT_COUNT or Config.MAX_PLOTS or 6
	for i = 1, plotCount do
		local ok, plot = pcall(PlotBuilder.buildPlot, i)
		if ok and plot ~= nil then
			table.insert(plots, plot)
		else
			warn("Plot build failed: " .. tostring(plot))
		end
	end

	ForgeTelemetry.count("map_built", 1)
end

buildWorld()

-- PlotClaimService is the single authority for claiming and auto-claiming.
callFirst(PlotClaimService, { "init", "start", "setup" }, plots)
callFirst(UpgradeService, { "init" })
callFirst(RebirthService, { "init" })
callFirst(CashInService, { "init", "start", "setup" }, plots)

-- Claim detection
-- Resolves the plot currently owned by a player (nil if none).
local function getClaimedPlot(player: Player): any?
	if type(PlotClaimService) == "table" then
		local getter = PlotClaimService.getPlot or PlotClaimService.getPlotFor
		if type(getter) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(getter, player)
			if ok and result ~= nil then
				if type(result) == "number" then
					return plots[result]
				end
				return result
			end
		end
	end
	local idx = player:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") or player:GetAttribute("ClaimedPlot")
	if type(idx) == "number" then
		return plots[idx]
	end
	return nil
end

local function hasClaimedPlot(player: Player): boolean
	if getClaimedPlot(player) ~= nil then
		return true
	end
	return player:GetAttribute("PlotIndex") ~= nil or player:GetAttribute("ClaimedPlot") ~= nil
end

-- Best-effort: finds the plot's Instance root from a plot value (Instance or table).
local function plotInstance(plot: any): Instance?
	if typeof(plot) == "Instance" then
		return plot
	end
	if type(plot) == "table" then
		local candidate = plot.model or plot.Model or plot.folder or plot.root or plot.instance
		if typeof(candidate) == "Instance" then
			return candidate
		end
	end
	return nil
end

Result: -- Upgrades: pure data for the dropper / ore tier / speed / cash multiplier tree.
-- No requires, no side effects. Returns { list = {...}, byId = {...}, ores = {...}, starterCash = n }.
--
-- This table is the SINGLE source of truth for upgrade prices. Shop cards, world pads, the
-- server purchase check, the tutorial text and the HUD "Next:" hint must all read cost from here.
-- Dropper 2 = 10 and Speed 1 (Fast Belt) = 22, matching the design doc, Config.STARTING_CASH (10)
-- and the tutorial text ("the pad costs $10").
--
-- BUDGET MATH
--   The first cube (Bronze) is worth 5 cash. The player starts with 10 cash, so the first buy
--   (Dropper 2, 10 cash) is affordable immediately after claiming a plot. After that, income is
--   5 cash/s (2 cubes per 2 s cycle x 5 cash), so every following purchase lands 4-24 s apart.
--   Total cost of all 10 upgrades:
--     10 + 22 + 60 + 150 + 300 + 500 + 800 + 1300 + 2200 + 4000 = 9342 cash
--   Income after each milestone (cubes per 2 s cycle x ore value x cash multiplier, per second),
--   and the approximate wait for the NEXT purchase at that income:
--     base                        1 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   2.5 /s   (Dropper 2 affordable immediately)
--     dropper2                    2 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   5   /s   (Speed 1, 22  -> ~4 s)
--     speed1                                           5   /s   (Silver, 60   -> ~8 s)
--     tier_silver                 2 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  12   /s   (Dropper 3, 150 -> ~12 s)
--     dropper3                    3 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  18   /s   (Cash x1.5, 300 -> ~17 s)
--     mult1 (x1.5)                3 x 12 x 1.5 / 2 =  27   /s   (Gold, 500 -> ~18 s)
--     tier_gold                   3 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  67.5 /s   (Speed 2, 800 -> ~12 s)
--     speed2                                          67.5 /s   (Dropper 4, 1300 -> ~19 s)
--     dropper4                    4 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  90   /s   (Cash x2, 2200 -> ~24 s)
--     mult2 (x2)                  4 x 30 x 2.0 / 2 = 120   /s   (Diamond, 4000 -> ~33 s)
--     tier_diamond                4 x 75 x 2.0 / 2 = 300   /s
--   (speed upgrades only shorten the trip to the collector.)
--
-- Effect shapes:
--   { kind = "dropper",  slots = n }   total active dropper slots after purchase
--   { kind = "tier",     tier = n }    ore tier every dropper spits out (index into ores)
--   { kind = "speed",    mult = x }    conveyor speed multiplier
--   { kind = "cashMult", mult = x }    collector cash multiplier
--
-- Optional presentation fields (read by the client for the purchase celebration):
--   label  = short headline string
--   popup  = RewardPopup text (shown with Win sting, shockwave ring and FOV punch for ore tiers)
--   color  = Color3 for the shockwave ring / popup (ore tiers)
--
-- Every `requires` points at an existing id, so pads reveal progressively.

local list = {
	{ id = "dropper2", name = "Dropper 2", cost = 10, requires = nil, effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 2 } },
	{ id = "speed1", name = "Speed 1", cost = 22, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_silver",
		name = "Silver Ore",
		cost = 60,
		requires = "dropper2",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 2 },
		label = "Silver Ore",
		popup = "SILVER ORE! $12 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220),
	},
	{ id = "dropper3", name = "Dropper 3", cost = 150, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 3 } },
	{ id = "mult1", name = "Cash x1.5", cost = 300, requires = "tier_silver", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_gold",
		name = "Gold Ore",
		cost = 500,
		requires = "tier_silver",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 3 },
		label = "Gold Ore",
		popup = "GOLD ORE! $30 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40),
	},
	{ id = "speed2", name = "Speed 2", cost = 800, requires = "speed1", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 2 } },
	{ id = "dropper4", name = "Dropper 4", cost = 1300, requires = "dropper3", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 4 } },
	{ id = "mult2", name = "Cash x2", cost = 2200, requires = "mult1", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 2 } },
	{
		id = "tier_diamond",
		name = "Diamond Ore",
		cost = 4000,
		requires = "tier_gold",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 4 },
		label = "Diamond Ore",
		popup = "DIAMOND ORE! $75 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255),
	},
}

-- Indexed by tier.
local ores = {
	{ name = "Bronze", value = 5, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Silver", value = 12, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Gold", value = 30, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), material = Enum.Material.Foil, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Diamond", value = 75, color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255), material = Enum.Material.Glass, sparkles = true },
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	byId[upgrade.id] = upgrade
end

-- Sanity check: every requirement must reference an existing upgrade id.
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	if upgrade.requires ~= nil and byId[upgrade.requires] == nil then
		warn("[Upgrades] " .. upgrade.id .. " requires unknown id " .. tostring(upgrade.requires))
	end
end

return {
	list = list,
	byId = byId,
	ores = ores,
	-- Starter grant: matches Config.STARTING_CASH so the first upgrade (Dropper 2, 10) is affordable immediately.
